gotchas: No signup link on the homepage itself: open the Sign in flyout and follow 'Create a MileagePlus account'. Guessed /member/enrollment and /fly/mileageplus/enroll.html URLs are 404s.

Stepped form. Step 1 ('Tell us about yourself') asks for email, phone (country code combobox + number), first/last name, date of birth (Month combobox, Day and Year textboxes) and Gender (combobox), then 'Continue'. No password field on step 1; the later steps were not driven.
Marketing, SMS and flight-update checkboxes are pre-checked.
'Create a MileagePlus account' in the Sign in flyout opens a NEW TAB (waitForPopup).

Step 1 'Tell us about yourself': Email address*, Country/region code* combobox + Phone number* (required), Title, First name*, Middle, Last name*, Suffix, DOB Month/Day/Year, Gender* combobox, then Continue. The plain address (no +tag) is accepted.
Marketing email, SMS offers and flight-update checkboxes are pre-checked.
